protocol_note: Thresholds are a human-approved protocol for this study and are not manufacturer performance claims.

source_registry.source_note: Source closed at the declared Menagerie commit and locally vendored for this experiment.

tasks.description: Hold an upright Spot posture at the current location.
tasks.criterion_summary: Study protocol: upright, stopped, and no body-floor contact for 1.0 s; not a manufacturer claim.

tasks.description: Adjust Spot to the specified body height and hold upright at the current location.
tasks.criterion_summary: Study protocol: body-height error at most 30 mm and upright for 1.0 s; not a manufacturer claim.

tasks.description: Move Spot forward in its initial body-yaw direction for a bounded distance, then stop upright.
tasks.criterion_summary: Study protocol: forward motion with <=50 mm lateral drift, upright/no-contact motion, and <=0.05 m/s terminal speed for 0.5 s; not a manufacturer claim.

tasks.description: Move Spot laterally in its initial body-yaw frame for a bounded distance, then stop upright.
tasks.criterion_summary: Study protocol: lateral motion with <=50 mm forward drift, upright/no-contact motion, and <=0.05 m/s terminal speed for 0.5 s; not a manufacturer claim.

tasks.description: Move Spot's arm to the specified joint posture and hold it.
tasks.criterion_summary: Study protocol: seven-joint maximum absolute error at most 0.02 rad for 0.5 s; not a manufacturer claim.
